_meta.dataset: rel-avito (RelBench), derived from the Kaggle 'Avito Context Ad Clicks' competition data

sources.semantics: Avito Context Ad Clicks data description (Kaggle) and the RelBench dataset description; reconstructed by the developer, so it needs human verification

_meta.status: provisional: the semantic key needs human verification; the relationship key is authoritative (RelBench)

adjudication_candidates._note: Plausible edges that are NOT in RelBench's metadata. They count as false positives in the primary metric and are listed separately for human adjudication.

AdsInfo.concept: A classified advertisement (listing) posted on the marketplace, with its category, location, price and title; includes both regular listings and paid contextual ads.

Category.concept: Ad category taxonomy (a hierarchy of categories and subcategories).

Location.concept: Geographic location (region/city hierarchy) of ads and searches.

UserInfo.concept: A site user/visitor, described by browser and device attributes (user agent, OS, device).

SearchInfo.concept: A search event: a user ran a search (a query and/or category/location filters) at a point in time.

SearchStream.concept: Ad impressions within search results: which ads were shown for each search, at what position, of what type, and whether the ad was clicked.

VisitStream.concept: Ad page views: a user opened/viewed an ad's page at a point in time.

PhoneRequestsStream.concept: Contact requests: a user asked to reveal the seller's phone number for an ad (a lead/contact event).

columns.AdsInfo.AdID: Unique identifier of the ad (primary key).
columns.AdsInfo.LocationID: Location of the ad (foreign key to Location).
columns.AdsInfo.CategoryID: Category of the ad (foreign key to Category).
columns.AdsInfo.Price: Price of the item or service advertised.
columns.AdsInfo.Title: Title text of the ad.
columns.AdsInfo.IsContext: Flag: whether the ad is a contextual (paid, highlighted-in-search) ad rather than a regular listing.
columns.Category.CategoryID: Unique identifier of the category (primary key).
columns.Category.Level: Depth of the category in the category hierarchy.
columns.Category.ParentCategoryID: Identifier of the parent category in the hierarchy.
columns.Category.SubcategoryID: Subcategory identifier / code within the hierarchy. Not documented; acceptable: any hierarchy-related identifier.
columns.Location.LocationID: Unique identifier of the location (primary key).
columns.Location.Level: Granularity level of the location (e.g., country/region/city). Not documented; acceptable: hierarchy level.
columns.Location.RegionID: Identifier of the region containing the location.
columns.Location.CityID: Identifier of the city of the location.
columns.PhoneRequestsStream.UserID: User who requested the phone number (foreign key to UserInfo).
columns.PhoneRequestsStream.IPID: Anonymized identifier of the requester's IP address (not a foreign key to any table).
columns.PhoneRequestsStream.AdID: Ad whose seller phone number was requested (foreign key to AdsInfo).
columns.SearchInfo.UserID: User who performed the search (foreign key to UserInfo).
columns.SearchInfo.SearchID: Unique identifier of the search event (primary key).
columns.SearchInfo.IPID: Anonymized identifier of the searcher's IP address (not a foreign key).
columns.SearchInfo.IsUserLoggedOn: Flag: whether the user was logged in when searching.
columns.SearchInfo.SearchQuery: Free-text search query entered by the user (may be empty).
columns.SearchInfo.LocationID: Location filter/context of the search (foreign key to Location).
columns.SearchInfo.CategoryID: Category filter/context of the search (foreign key to Category).
columns.SearchStream.SearchID: The search in which the ad was shown (foreign key to SearchInfo).
columns.SearchStream.AdID: The ad that was shown (foreign key to AdsInfo).
columns.SearchStream.Position: Position (rank/slot) of the ad on the search results page.
columns.SearchStream.ObjectType: Type of ad shown: regular, highlighted, or contextual (categorical code).
columns.SearchStream.HistCTR: Historical click-through rate of the ad (for contextual ads).
columns.SearchStream.IsClick: Flag: whether the shown ad was clicked (recorded for contextual ads; missing otherwise).
columns.SearchStream.SearchDate: Timestamp of the search in which the impression occurred.
columns.UserInfo.UserID: Unique identifier of the user (primary key).
columns.UserInfo.UserAgentID: Identifier of the user's browser user-agent string.
columns.UserInfo.UserAgentOSID: Identifier of the user's operating system.
columns.UserInfo.UserDeviceID: Identifier of the user's device type/model.
columns.UserInfo.UserAgentFamilyID: Identifier of the user's browser family.
columns.VisitStream.UserID: User who viewed the ad (foreign key to UserInfo).
columns.VisitStream.IPID: Anonymized identifier of the viewer's IP address (not a foreign key).
columns.VisitStream.AdID: Ad whose page was viewed (foreign key to AdsInfo).

outcome.definition: For each (UserID, cutoff timestamp t), label = 1 if the user visits more than one ad in [t, t + 4 days). Label column in the task files: num_click (bool).
